purpose: Make family search and rejection decisions auditable so exact/version does not look like a cherry-picked survivor.
read: The ledger records every request-family class currently used in the paper package, including negative and mined-but-not-admitted cases. It is an audit-order ledger reconstructed from dated evidence artifacts, not a claim of perfect wall-clock experiment chronology.

key_thresholds: 24/25 (0.960 [0.805, 0.993]); frame ablation 37/40 strict positives vs 3/80 controls; title overlap 37/37
106/107 (0.991 [0.949, 0.998]); LLM adjudication chose request 94/94 (1.000 [0.961, 1.000]); duplicate baseline same canonical title 0/94
rows.pre_or_post_readout: developed on dev/val; full-train and Blind B readouts frozen separately
rows.why_not_cherry_pick: matched official-label, no-feature, wrong-positive, and cross-dialogue controls are recorded separately

rows.attempt: same resolver as exact/version, but allowing catalog versions/duplicates
key_thresholds: devset has 1 version/duplicate record; train has 5 version records
rows.pre_or_post_readout: bundled with exact/version before final framing; not promoted as separate family
rows.why_not_cherry_pick: reported as rare rather than inflated into a separate contribution

rows.attempt: imperative named-artist constraints with broad parser
key_thresholds: learned broad hard specialist is useful stress evidence but action precision is weaker than exact/version
rows.pre_or_post_readout: broad failure analysis precedes the stricter simple/non-negated selector
rows.why_not_cherry_pick: broad failure is retained in the selector ladder and limits the hard-family claim

rows.attempt: abstaining hard-artist selector excluding exact-title, quoted-title, album/year/era, lyric/example, and local-negation cases
key_thresholds: selector ladder broad 37/50 -> simple/no-exact 12/13 strict precision, but simple changes only 13 val rows and independent labels cover postrank changed rows only
rows.why_not_cherry_pick: reported as supporting, not headline, because selector precision and transfer are weaker than exact/version

rows.attempt: strict requests to move away from a rejected item/source or avoid a repeated previous item
key_thresholds: violation@1 0.964 -> 0.214, but violation@20 1.000 -> 1.000; gold moved down 21/28; oracle sidecar top-100 clean-top20 feasible 0/28
rows.pre_or_post_readout: tested as conservative masking/suppression; never promoted to headline
rows.why_not_cherry_pick: negative result is retained in the paper to show the contract rejects visible but unsafe actions

rows.attempt: album-name constraints mined from the same sidecar workflow
key_thresholds: The current parser finds real album conflicts, but fuzzy album-name resolution also produces visible false actions. On val, only 3/7 album constraints resolve to an album string literally present in the request, and 4/7 have low token overlap with the visible request. On train, 7/77 album sidecar actions would mask a gold item whose metadata already satisfies the parsed album.
rows.pre_or_post_readout: additional-family mining after initial exact/hard/switch detectors
rows.why_not_cherry_pick: literal salvage subset is disclosed but not promoted because dev coverage is 0

rows.attempt: release-year and decade constraints enabled in mining sidecar
key_thresholds: The enabled detector has broad coverage but weak action semantics: release_date can mean reissue or catalog date, open-ended era requests are treated as hard single intervals, and the current parser truncates ranges such as 2014-2015 to the first year.
rows.pre_or_post_readout: additional-family mining; not used for training claims
rows.why_not_cherry_pick: broad coverage is reported, but unsafe range/date semantics block admission

key_thresholds: screening request-like 23-25/25 per category; trusted target sets 0/125

These requests are frequent and important, but the current catalog does not expose high-precision fields that turn them into reusable request-satisfying target sets without model or human adjudication.
rows.pre_or_post_readout: additional-family mining; not converted to labels
rows.why_not_cherry_pick: frequent families are retained as rejected evidence because catalog fields cannot certify satisfaction

rows.attempt: inspect generator traces for policy/request boundary language
rows.pre_or_post_readout: offline qualitative audit; forbidden as detector or inference input
rows.why_not_cherry_pick: traces support vocabulary only; deployable detectors remain visible-dialogue/catalog based
